gloss: to stick in one's ears; to stay with one (of a sound)

definitions.gloss: to stick in one's ears; to linger in the memory (of a sound or voice)
definitions.explanation: Said of a melody, voice, or remark that keeps coming back to one after it is heard. The sound is the subject and takes が; the person who remembers it is usually left unstated.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{耳|みみ}に{残|のこ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: That song is still stuck in my head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{耳|みみ}に{残|のこ}って⟦{離|はな}れない→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: Those last words keep ringing in my ears.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子守歌|こもりうた}→子守歌：19434_komoriuta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{耳|みみ}に{残|のこ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The lullaby my grandmother sang when I was little still stays with me.

notes:
USAGE:
The て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form is the normal one, describing the ongoing state of a sound that will not go away. Both pleasant and unpleasant sounds qualify — a catchy tune, a scolding, a scream.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳|みみ}に{残|のこ}る⟦メロディー→メロディー：05877_merodii⟧: a melody that sticks with you
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{耳|みみ}に{残|のこ}る: for words to keep echoing
- {耳|みみ}に{残|のこ}って⟦{離|はな}れない→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: to be impossible to get out of one's head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to stay in one's heart — about the emotional impression, not the sound itself
- ⟦{耳|みみ}に{付|つ}く→耳に付く：18421_miminitsuku⟧: for a sound to grate on one after repeated hearing (negative only)
